title: Wizards Play Network 2025: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."
"The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day. But you are not here to see it."
"Now is the time... for the death of you all!"
The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.
"My, what big paws y—" —Thomas the woodsman, last words
